whoami.description: Print your own herdr pane identity (PANE_ID/WORKSPACE/TAB/AGENT/LABEL/FOCUSED) from $HERDR_PANE_ID

resolve.description: Discover pane id(s) from a soft ref (right/left/up/down, tab:N, focused, name). Multi-candidate refs exit non-zero and list every PANE_ID — pick one before sending

send-signed.description: Send a signed message into a concrete pane id only (e.g. w1:p2). Soft refs (right/left/...) rejected - resolve first. Default signature is one-way: the receiver pushes nothing back and the sender waits + reads. --await-reply appends a push-reply command instead - REPL senders ending their turn only, never combined with wait+read. Usage: send-signed [--await-reply] <pane_id> "<message>"

new-tab-run.description: Open a new tab in your workspace (no focus steal) and run a command in its root pane; prints PANE_ID=<root>. Usage: new-tab-run "<label>" "<command>"
